explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/1042: Ghosh–Ramachandran proved that 'if d ≤ 1/4 and F is connected then the set has only one connected component'. The Lean statement: for closed connected F with 0 < transfiniteDiameter F ≤ 1/4, every monic f of degree n ≥ 1 with all roots in F has numComponents f = 1. The side conditions n ≥ 1 (otherwise the set is empty) and d > 0 are harmless and documented. Faithful.
